Title: Face or feet swelling, foam in your urine? Watch these 3 foods

Description:
If your face or feet keep swelling and you're seeing foam in the toilet, it could be a sign your kidneys are working overtime — and three everyday foods might be the reason.

Deli meat, bread, and canned soup don't taste especially salty, but they're some of the biggest sodium sources in the American diet according to the CDC. Too much sodium makes your body hold onto water and strains your kidneys, which can let protein leak into your urine.

Watch to see exactly how much sodium is hiding in each one, and easy label tricks to cut it down.
